title: Robert D. Hare Lifetime Achievement Award
html: Kent Kiehl received the 2026 Robert D. Hare Lifetime Achievement Award, the highest honor of the Society for the Scientific Study of Psychopathy (SSSP).
text: Kent Kiehl received the 2026 Robert D. Hare Lifetime Achievement Award from the Society for the Scientific Study of Psychopathy.

title: Keynote at CrimeCon 2026 in Las Vegas
html: Dr. Kiehl gave an invited keynote, “What makes them tick? Inside the mind of a psychopath,” at CrimeCon 2026 at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. About 6,000 people attended the conference.
text: Invited keynote at CrimeCon 2026, Caesars Palace, Las Vegas.
